style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, no drawn overlays
motion_rule: HE is the subject of every window; only one of them moves; HIS BODY crosses the frame edge to edge in EVERY window, talking ones too; his legs stay in shot, no prop between his body and the lens, never facing the lens while talking; the camera never carries a window alone; new shot size every window; no window ends on a grip or a stop
character: a glossy red lobster in a black tailcoat, a monocle in one eye, a gold signet ring flashing on his big claw, whipping antennae, ONE huge claw and one small
second_characters: ONE plump crab in a bow tie, waiting on him
props: CARD: one blank cream price card on a string. DOME: one glass dome on a red velvet stand
prop_continuity: one and the same card throughout, streaming from his small claw or dragging over the gravel, never up at his chest; the dome stands empty until 9.3; speech is only heard, never shown
environment: the WHOLE clip is INSIDE a rich glass tank, underwater, gravel floor, a marble side table with a bowl of grapes and fruit, gilt-framed paintings and velvet banquettes in the salon beyond the glass
lighting: bright chandelier light through the glass, water sparkling, high exposure

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: deep chesty male voice, calm and unhurried, even 4.3 syllables per second
audio.pronunciation: go-vo-RYAT, DO-ro-go, le-ZHU, DU-ma-yu, po-do-ro-ZHAT, ye-SHCHO, kol-lek-tsi-ON-nym
audio.pacing: speech 0.7-2.5 and 2.9-7.9; voiceless outside, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth and mandibles open on every syllable, not a voice over
audio.sfx: water swirl, gravel spraying, claw snaps, cutlery clinking beyond the glass, the dome ringing at 9.3

timeline.a: silent. THE LOBSTER bursts out of the gravel and crosses the whole tank low past the lens, the blank card streaming from his small claw
he rockets up the inside of the glass the whole height of the frame, gravel raining off him
he kicks off the glass and rakes the tank end to end in profile, the card dragging over the gravel
no words. THE CRAB hauls the velvet stand the whole width of the tank and swings the dome up onto it
THE LOBSTER flips onto his back and slides the whole width of the tank through the gravel, claws folded
still on his back he thrashes his tail and shoots the length of the tank past the stand
he rolls off his back and drives up the gravel slope the whole height of the frame
he climbs the glass claw over claw the whole height of the tank, the card hauled up the gravel after him
he kicks off the glass and sails the whole width of the tank over the stand, the card streaming after him
no words. THE LOBSTER rams the stand with his shoulder and rides it the whole width of the tank
no words. THE CRAB runs the length of the tank and hooks the card onto the dome
THE LOBSTER shoots up the whole frame onto the velvet and rides the falling dome down at the lens, winking, his monocle flashing

must_appear: the crab swinging the dome onto the velvet at 2.5, the card hooked onto the dome at 8.6, the dome coming down over him and the wink at 9.3, the tailcoat, monocle and ring on him throughout, the grapes and the paintings in shot
negative_prompt: speech bubble, comic balloon, caption box, any lettering, cyrillic, subtitles, watermark, digits on the card, a second price card, the hero outside the tank, night, dark scene, a still camera, a push in, macro on a small prop, a logo, slow motion, any word after 7.9, silence in the tail
